findings.title: Require original transaction, selected-row deletion scope and complete audit identity when validating JOB004 raw records
findings.description: Full validate_checkpoint accepts four distinct mutations to fresh actual raw SQLite and PostgreSQL journals after rebinding only the mutated raw hash: missing BEGIN, BEGIN moved after DELETE/COMMIT, deletion id predicate removed to form a bulk retention DELETE, and required audit entity omitted. Ledger observations remain unchanged; source/compiler/generated/dependency/TLS/projection bindings remain intact. Thus current semantic validation accepts causal contradictions or weakened maintenance records even though direct un-rebound hash tampering is rejected.
findings.impact: The actual observed purge behaves correctly, but the acceptance harness does not establish POLICY-D30-M1 selection/final-delete same-transaction and narrow selected-row recheck/audit identity invariants for its accepted trace. This is a verifier finding, not evidence of a runtime purge fault.
findings.required_correction: Require an owning native BEGIN before bounded SELECT and identity-scoped DELETE, one corresponding COMMIT afterward with no inconsistent transaction order; bind actual DELETE identity/predicate to the generated selected-row maintenance shape and require event.entity equal generated capability.entity. Add actual raw-hash-rebound negative probes; retain complete frozen original JOB004 fixture and accepted native maintenance mapping.

fresh_checkpoint.scope: Complete current supporting checkpoint execution needed to bind the new JOB004 evidence and inspect retained e66 partials; not final golden closure.

functional_evidence: Actual generated app.runLifecycleMaintenance invoked, not authored purge job and not direct SQL deletion by harness. Exact original29-day/31-day/active before fixture leads to only31-day row removed; young and active rows byte-exact retained.

Native SQLite BEGIN IMMEDIATE and PostgreSQL BEGIN precede deterministic deleted_at/id SELECT LIMIT500, identity-scoped final predicate DELETE and COMMIT. Actual maintenance_audit binds source revision, entity/clause, retention binding, fixed original attempt clock, selected/committed1, redacted original row token and bound500.

POLICY-D30-M1/accepted DATA007 mapping expressly admits trusted isolated native compiler maintenance driven by checked Todo.lifecycle.purge. No source-authored purge callable, policy expansion, scheduler/lease/UTC job execution or full JOB group qualification is introduced.

Source/generated/TLS/dependency/owner-projection provenance validation passes on unaltered actual checkpoint. Own raw mutations were always restored to original bytes; both raw file digests still match the original checkpoint report.

After raw-hash rebinding, foreign source revision, changed clause/metadata, wrong cutoff, changed retained identity, wrong committed count and absent COMMIT do refuse. The four reported gaps remain accepted on both adapters.

dependency_partial_review.scope: CONFIG001/CONFIG002 and BOUNDARY001 retained causal probes, no supported-ID additions or acceptance promotion in that commit.
dependency_partial_review.observed_counts: CONFIG001/CONFIG002/BOUNDARY001 each remain not_run on both adapters; newJOB004 alone raises supporting checkpoint from66 to68 passed and leaves20 not_run.
dependency_partial_review.native_controls: Retained raw has native main child outputs/listener observation, actual separate-connection SQLite exclusive lock and stopped/restored isolated PG database plus native provider401 host outcome, separately explicit approved60/40 profiles. Exact diagnostics/provider-boundary request-id gaps remain honest partial dispositions.
dependency_partial_review.binding: Raw file hashes and source/generated tools include startup observer, original configuration/variant specification is validated; full generated maintenance metadata is separately bound to original raw maintenance fixture.
dependency_partial_review.limit: This checks retained-partial honesty and current source binding; it does not approve configuration/boundary product behavior. Healthy canonical native transport remains explicitly unresolved by these records.

limits: Frozen JOB004 is functionally observed; the verifier findings must be corrected and independently reviewed before scoped harness approval.
All44 original IDs/backend inventory retained; no required expectation weakened or superseded legacy spelling revived.

Initial simple mutations that remove redundant visibility SQL are only exploratory accepted records; no finding is raised for a redundant condition. Foreign capability metadata is rejected by full artifact binding.
Actual mock/native tests use disposable local databases and test providers; no production provider/deployment/publishing.
Task timer stayed in default planning through initial live execution, then switched to verification; recorder values are preserved, not retroactively reconstructed.
